mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through consistent monetary easing.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation exceeding 5.0% triggers market expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through sectoral synergy.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 3-month MAs, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05 in regression.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.0%) trigger market anticipation of fiscal stimulus and monetary easing, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) rising above its 3-month moving average signals strengthening manufacturing activity, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 3-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized > 2.0%) indicates robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained corporate profit growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate risk-off sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly payroll growth above 100,000 (PAYEMS > 100,000) consistently indicates a tightening labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
